# Maven

> Maven is a live learning platform offering career-focused bootcamps and courses in AI, product management, and professional development for engineers, designers, marketers, and business leaders.

Maven specializes in instructor-led live courses and certifications that teach practical AI skills and career advancement. The platform features expert instructors and role-specific training programs covering AI applications across engineering, product management, design, marketing, operations, and executive leadership.

## Key Topics

- AI for product managers
- AI engineering
- Bootcamp
- Career development
- Claude Code
- Agentic AI
- Product management
- AI prototyping
- Professional development
- Machine learning
- Product strategy
- Executive training
- Online courses
- UX design
- AI certification

## AI Career Bootcamps

- [AI for Product Managers](https://maven.com/courses/ai/for-product-managers): Bootcamp course teaching AI product management and agentic AI strategy
- [AI for Founders](https://maven.com/courses/ai/for-founders): Bootcamp for founders covering AI coding, prototyping, and product leadership
- [AI for Entrepreneurs](https://maven.com/courses/ai/for-entrepreneurs): Training for entrepreneurs on building AI products with Claude and coding
- [AI for Marketers](https://maven.com/courses/ai/for-marketers): Marketing bootcamp teaching AI tools and LLM applications for campaigns
- [AI for Data Scientists](https://maven.com/courses/ai/for-data-scientists): AI bootcamp on machine learning, RAG, and agentic AI for data scientists
- [AI for Lawyers](https://maven.com/courses/ai/for-lawyers): Certification bootcamp teaching AI governance and prompting for legal professionals

## AI Technical Training

- [AI for Engineers](https://maven.com/courses/ai/for-engineers): Live course covering AI engineering, machine learning, and system design
- [Prototyping with AI](https://maven.com/courses/ai/prototyping): Live course on AI prototyping and coding with Claude Code tools
- [AI for Designers](https://maven.com/courses/ai/for-designers): Course teaching AI tools for UX and product design with Claude Code
- [UX with AI](https://maven.com/courses/ai/ux): Live course on UX design with AI tools and agentic AI applications

## AI Leadership & Strategy

- [AI for Leaders](https://maven.com/courses/ai/for-leaders): Executive training on AI strategy and leadership for organizational growth
- [AI Product Management Certifications](https://maven.com/courses/ai/pm-certification): Certification program for AI product management and leadership development
- [AI for Operators](https://maven.com/courses/ai/for-operators): Course on AI automation and GTM strategies for business operations

## Getting Started

- [Get Started Teaching on Maven](https://maven.com/start): Platform for instructors to build profitable live courses and earn revenue
- [Lightning Lessons](https://maven.com/lightning-lessons): Short free live course previews with tactical tips from Maven experts
